what: Bug claims from upstream issues tastejs/todomvc #2309–#2315 (filed 6 Nov 2026 by someone else, with a different AI browser agent, re-checked with Playwright), scored against what Kane reported when replaying the jQuery recordings on each official implementation. Kane never saw the issues. Each claim is also re-checked without AI (docs/impl-recheck.json).

The sentence says "its newly appended item displays 'Call home'" without saying where, and the recorded check finds the item by its text. A fresh run of the same sentence (the replay audit) passed too. Rewritten to name the order, the sentence caught it in a fresh run: "Adding 'Call home' put it above 'Buy milk' instead of below it."

beyondTheKey.note: Not in the upstream reports. Kane: "The mark-all control changes its own appearance but does not apply the completed state to the todo." The build binds its click handler to the label (`$toggleAll = $(".toggle-all-label")`), so clicking the checkbox itself, or pressing Space on it, ticks the box and leaves every todo active.
beyondTheKey.recheck: mark-all by clicking the checkbox itself

evidence.kane: Selecting “Mark all as complete” left one existing todo active and unchecked.
Using the mark-all control leaves the only todo unchecked and the footer still shows 1 item left.

beyondTheKey.note: Kane: "Selecting Completed leaves the Todo list on the All filter instead of activating Completed." Clicking Completed selects it and shows only the completed todo.

evidence.kane: Selecting Completed leaves the Todo list on the All filter instead of activating Completed.

beyondTheKey.note: Kane: "the new-todo field is visible but is not the active field." It is the active field, inside Lit's shadow DOM.

evidence.kane: After the todo app loads, the new-todo field is visible but is not the active field.

beyondTheKey.note: The footer reads "0 items left!" where the jQuery app reads "0 items left". (The React build writes the same "!"; there Kane called its own check unclear.)

evidence.kane: After all todos were completed, the footer verification found that the counter did not meet the required structure.
